Messages.Author: Jannu
Messages.Body:
For example I use Sniper rifle to set range long as blocking minion. Can i use primal instinct to change my strike after my opponent has chosen his strike? Normaly I would be forced to shhot with my sniper rifle, can i instead play primal instinct and strike something else?

Auspex Strike: dodge.
Auspex Only usable by the acting vampire after the opposing minion has chosen his or her strike. Cancel this acting vampire's strike and choose a new one.

Potence, if it doesn't work, you just aren't using enough

National Coordinator of Finland
Prince of Hämeenlinna

Messages.Author: Izaak
Messages.Body:
You can play Primal Instinct, sure.

You are then allowed to choose a new strike, but since you are forced to strike with the Sniper Rifle due to using its set range ability, the only new strike you can choose is shooting with the Sniper Rifle.

Messages.Author: Malachy
Izaak
Messages.Body:
Oh ye of course, Primal Instinct at AUS can only be played by the acting vampire, as per its card text. Sniper Rifle's special can only be used by blocking minions, so the question is moot.

However, you could run into the same scenario after having maneuvered with a .44 Magnum. The answer, in that case, would be what I wrote.

Messages.Author: Jannu
Messages.Body:
Yes, of course, but the magnum example is valid and ansvers the question. Thank you.
